name: Pregabalin
executiveSummary: α2δ ligand (GABA analogue). Adult neuropathic pain/anxiety: start **75 mg q12h** → **150–300 mg/day** (max **600 mg/day**). Adjunct partial epilepsy: similar. Strict renal adjustment. Sedation, dizziness, abuse potential.
indications:
## Indications

- Neuropathic pain (diabetic, postherpetic); neuralgia; GAD; adjunct partial epilepsy; fibromyalgia (labels).

## Precautions

- Reduce dose by CrCl (label tables).
- Taper on withdrawal (insomnia, rebound anxiety).
- Edema, weight gain; blurred vision.
- Controlled in some countries (abuse).

> Not an opioid — useful in neuropathic pain without typical opioid respiratory ceiling.

adulto.dose: Start **75 mg q12h** or **50 mg q8h**; over 3–7 days to **150–300 mg/day**. Max **600 mg/day**. CKD: e.g. CrCl 30–60 → max **300 mg/day**; <30 per table.

adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Dizziness, somnolence, peripheral edema, weight gain, dry mouth; rare: angioedema, suicidal ideation.
